en.topic_title: China says Philippine plane ‘intruded’ airspace over disputed waters

zh.topic_title: China says Philippine plane ‘intruded’ airspace over disputed waters

en.topic_title: China says Philippine plane ‘intruded’ airspace over disputed waters
en.topic_summary:
Beijing warned Manila on Monday against “provocative acts” in the disputed South China Sea, accusing a Philippine aircraft of an airspace violation over the weekend.



Scarborough Shoal in 2015. Photo: NASA.



Beijing claims most of the sea, despite an international ruling that its assertion has no legal basis, and confrontations have occurred regularly.



The Philippine armed forces said a Chinese fighter jet had interfered with a “routine military patrol” carried out
